title: SKEL-01 Panel fixes: late final ack anchor (M1), signer flood caps (M2), agent_id↔connection check (S3), unprivileged shared uid (S2)
outcome: Honest runs always verify with --head; a flooding rogue cannot bloat gateway memory or stall ticks
acceptance: test: late witness ack → anchor equals newest verified checkpoint; verify --head OK
test: signer flood → refusals counted not stored, per-socket per-tick line cap, connection closed; tick time bounded
test: envelope agent_id ≠ connection's agent → deny bad_sig on that conn
--shared-uid runs agents under one unprivileged uid, never 0
summary: M1: WitnessLink keeps the newest signature-verified ack (late ones too) and close() drains the socket after the witness exits; run() anchors from witness.newest. M2: SignerService.refusals is a Counter (counted, not stored), per-tick line budget MAX_SIGNER_LINES_PER_TICK=8, handle() returns None past it and the barrier closes that connection (tick stays bounded, other agents unaffected). S3: Gateway binds conn_id to the barrier's agent per tick; envelope agent_id != connection's agent -> deny/bad_sig (sig_ok False). S2: spawn.plan_agent_uids; as root --shared-uid runs agents under one unprivileged uid (60001), never 0; banner/K2/teardown follow. Tests in tests/panel/test_skel01_panel_fixes.py pass natively (M1, M2 x2, S3, uid plan). LINUX-ROOT-ONLY, UNEXECUTED (skipped on macOS): test_shared_uid_run_as_root_uses_one_unprivileged_uid. Also unexecuted until the container: tests/witness/test_witness.py::test_witness_file_owned_by_witness_uid_mode_0600_and_gateway_holds_no_fd (B3-08). Full suite: 506 passed, 6 skipped.
review: [kabir · done] Accept. M1: newest = highest-count signature-verified ack, late acks drained after the witness exits. The anchor is never newer than a verified witness line, and the test verifies anchored --head. M2: refusals is a Counter, an 8-line per-tick budget, the flooder is closed, the tick is bounded, other agents unaffected. Path-less socketpairs mean a rogue cannot open more connections. A non-reading rogue only drops replies (non-blocking send), with no stall. Memory is bounded: _sig_in is capped at MAX_FRAME_BYTES and each read is at most 64 KiB. S3: the check is in _sig_ok, before nonce/action consumption and before any state effect, and the deny is recorded (sig_ok False, conn_id). S2: plan_agent_uids never gives an agent uid 0, and K2 and teardown cover the shared uid. FOLLOW-UPS (non-blocking): (a) an oversize or no-LF signer partial is silently cleared, not counted or closed. A drip never spends budget and can keep the select loop busy until the deadline, so count it as a line or close it (parity with gw F8). (b) S3 fails open when conn_id has no binding (direct admit() outside tick()). Deny unbound non-system conns. UNEXECUTED: test_shared_uid_run_as_root_uses_one_unprivileged_uid is Linux-root-only. It must pass in the container before the wave's demo.
